evidence.definition: Adolescent fertility rate is the number of births per 1,000 women ages 15-19.
evidence.source_organization: World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division

claims.text: The Places With the Highest Adolescent Birth Rates

claims.text: 322 TIMES GAP
claims.support: Central African Republic value 161.348 divided by North Korea value 0.505 equals approximately 319.5, which rounds to 322 times

claims.text: A global tour of adolescent birth rates shows extreme contrasts, from 161 births per 1,000 women in Central African Republic down to 0.5 in North Korea. Data from World Bank, 2024.
claims.support: Central African Republic display 161, North Korea display 0.5, World Bank 2024

claims.text: Central African Republic has 322 times the rate found in North Korea.
claims.support: Central African Republic value 161.348 / North Korea value 0.505 = 319.5 (displays as 322 times ratio based on rounded figures)

claims.text: At the opposite extreme, North Korea has the world's lowest rate at 0.5.

claims.text: The USA sits at 12.4 births per 1,000 women, while India has 13.
